zh-TW.speaker: clark
zh-TW.text: 三對三半場缺一，要不要來挑一場？

zh-TW.speaker: bohan
zh-TW.text: 等我熱身一下，今天三分球手感火燙喔！

en.speaker: clark
en.text: 3-on-3 half court short one player, wanna play a match?

en.speaker: bohan
en.text: Let me warm up, my three-pointer touch is on fire today!

zh-TW.speaker: jerry
zh-TW.text: 防守別放水啊，切入禁區要頂住！

zh-TW.speaker: kerry
zh-TW.text: 放心，這記追魂麻辣鍋我蓋定了。

en.speaker: jerry
en.text: Don't slack on defense, hold the paint against the drive!

en.speaker: kerry
en.text: Don't worry, this chase-down block is all mine.
